About this video

Created by Maths by Zosiama. Question 2: The coordinates of the midpoint of the line segment joining the points A(2p + 1, 4) and B(5, q − 1) are (2p, q). Find the values of p and q. Answer: p = 3, q = 3.

Every frame is drawn in code on one canvas as a pure function of time (60 fps). No video models, stock footage, photos or AI images. Narration: Kokoro-82M voice (Apache-2.0), generated offline. Music and sound effects: synthesised in code. Fonts: Fredoka (SIL OFL 1.1) and a DejaVu Sans subset for maths symbols (Bitstream Vera licence).
